name: @ai-crew-suite/ollama-container
description: Ollama container for the AI Crew Suite platform

scripts.build: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image build ollama-container
scripts.lint: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image lint ollama-container
scripts.image:test:security: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image test security ollama-container
scripts.image:test:structure: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image test structure ollama-container
scripts.publish: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image publish ollama-container
scripts.image:promote: yarn run -T backstage-cli workbench image promote ollama-container
scripts.test: yarn image:test:security && yarn image:test:structure && yarn test:unit ollama-container
